Title: Rohan and the Family

Cast

1. Rohan - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Ananya - 9 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Sonali - 41 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ananya stands in the living room. Rohan and Sonali stand near her.]

Rohan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ananya applies kajal to her eyes.]

Rohan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Rohan serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Sonali: "Hmm, I see."

[Rohan's phone rings and he answers it.]

Rohan: "Ananya, are you okay?"

[Rohan sits down on a chair.]

Rohan: "That was such a fun day!"
